description:
Transactional outbox as a Spring Boot starter: library-owned
    Liquibase DDL, an at-least-once relay claiming by lease (an ordered lane and a
    concurrent lane), a pluggable
    publisher SPI (Kafka default, HTTP with per-row client-profile selection), and the
    /ops maintenance TRIO — prune, unpark, and a TMF630-shaped pending list.
